SPY.title: Warren Buffett Sold His Entire Stake in These ETFs Before the Current Sell-Off. Should You Follow His Lead?
SPY.description: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway sold its entire stake in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF and SPDR S&P 500 Trust ETF, leading to speculation about an impending stock market downturn. However, the article advises against following Buffett's lead, as the average investor should focus on long-term investing in broad market indices.
SPY.author: Stefon Walters

SPY.title: US Stocks Likely To Open Lower, But 'Economic Conditions Don't Signal A Downturn,' Say Analysts As They Expect 'Resilient Earnings' To Lift Equities
SPY.description: US stock futures declined on Friday, but analysts expect resilient earnings to lift equities despite concerns about higher inflation and lower economic growth.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra

SPY.title: S&P 500 Could Soar 12% By Year-End—But Only If Recession Is Avoided, Goldman Sachs Says
SPY.description: The S&P 500 could climb 12% to 6,200 by 2025 if the U.S. economy avoids a recession, according to Goldman Sachs. The 'Magnificent 7' tech firms are planning a 32% increase in capital expenditures, signaling confidence in AI and cloud growth.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
